zh-CN.title: 好友上线提醒更及时
items: 好友上线消息仅通过系统通知与即时提醒发送，不再进入延迟邮件队列
通知设置会明确禁用好友上线的邮件与短信渠道

en.title: Timelier friend-online alerts
items: Friend-online events now use system and instant notifications only, never delayed email delivery
Notification settings now clearly disable email and SMS for friend-online alerts
